news.text: The margrave has doubled the salt toll at the border post, and carters are turning back rather than pay it.
A cloth merchant's wagon was robbed at Wolf's Bend two nights ago; the thieves took the dyes and left the silk.
The margrave has been abed with a fever for a week, and the manor kitchen is told to send up nothing but broth.
The fort captain means to close the pass to wagons at the first hard snow; riders and walkers will still get through.
Three men deserted from the fort last week and are thought to be hiding in the charcoal burners' huts below the pass.

relationships.note: Brida nursed Edda through a winter fever years ago; since then they trade remedies, recipes and gossip.
Rurik has searched Toren's bales at the toll gate twice this season and found nothing; each thinks the other is laughing at him.
